title: Tiny
text:
Tiny. Tiny. I couldn't believe the ad said this thing could work in a room up to 2200ft...It doesn't look like it could clear the humidity in my small closet.
Needless to say it's going back and I'm getting a " real" dehumidifier for upstairs. I had hoped I could get a more compact model but alas, it's going to be one of those bulky things but at least I know they work.

product_metadata.title: Pure Enrichment® PureDry™ Mini Dehumidifier - Compact Water Tank Eliminates 300ml/day in Excess Moisture from Closets, Bathrooms, Boats, Kitchens and Other Small Rooms and Living Spaces
features: TRANSPARENT REMOVABLE WATER TANK: Easily keep track of the water level as the unit extracts moisture from the air, reducing other moisture-loving allergens
EASY CONVENIENT OPERATION: Our portable and compact product makes dehumidification simple, with a single switch that turns the unit on and off
INTELLIGENT AUTO SHUT-OFF: This unique dehumidifier automatically turns off when the water tank is full for safety and to prevent overflowing
WHISPER-QUIET OPERATION: PureDry Mini operates quietly in the background making it perfect for small spaces like a bathroom, closet, nursery or office

WHAT YOU GET: Dehumidifier, AC power adapter, user manual, and Pure Enrichment’s guaranteed 5-Year Warranty. Our customer support team provides daily quality service and peace of mind to millions worldwide all from a brand you can trust.
